input:
UFS 4.0 latency outliers during burst camera capture. Frame deadline is 16.6ms (60fps) but every ~2 minutes a single write takes 220ms, causing missed frames.

blktrace excerpt:
  [120.012] write 4MB queued
  [120.013] WB enabled (write booster)
  [120.234] write 4MB completed (221ms!)
  [120.235] dmesg: ufs: turbo write buffer flush triggered

What internal UFS 4.0 device state transition causes a 200+ms outlier? How does the WriteBooster turbo buffer flush interact with foreground I/O? What `ufs-bsg` knob can clamp WB buffer size to bound worst-case latency?
